entries.source: PHContentEditingController.h of the iOS 16.4 SDK and of the iOS 26.2 SDK, whose three required methods name PHAdjustmentData, PHContentEditingInput and PHContentEditingOutput; registry/Photos/absent_Photos.json, where those three classes are absent and each says why; sdk-26.2-surface.tsv for the row and its introduced release

PHLivePhotoView.h of the iOS 16.4 SDK and of the iOS 26.2 SDK, whose livePhoto property is typed PHLivePhoto *; registry/Photos/absent_Photos.json, where PHLivePhoto is absent and says why; tools/cache-index/first-rung.lua, which reads PHLivePhoto first at 9.1 and no held release of this port below it

PHLivePhotoView.h of the iOS 16.4 SDK and of the iOS 26.2 SDK, whose four delegate methods all take a PHLivePhotoView; registry/PhotosUI/absent_PhotosUI.json for the row of that class; tools/cache-index/first-rung.lua, which reads PHLivePhotoViewDelegate first at 9.2 and no held release of this port below it
